failure.cause: Polling for an allocation event did not guarantee cancellation preceded completion. An optimised encoder may complete before the polling task is scheduled.

change: Replace scheduling-dependent test with deterministic cancellation inside a parallel worker (signal observed, callbacks joined) and public cancellation from completion callback (result not published, source retained). These separately validate worker and public publication boundaries; no claim of end-to-end mid-worker task cancellation timing is made.
